image.alt: The four hominin skull casts from the lesson's opening, standing in a row, unlabelled, from the smallest-brained to the flat-faced modern skull.

options.text: Homo habilis. The earliest toolmaker must have moved first.
Homo erectus. It walked upright and carried big stone tools.
Homo sapiens. Our own species must have led the way.
Homo neanderthalensis. It was the first to reach Europe.
